log: Enemy commander used sword for 2 damage and took 3 in retaliation.
Your trident guard used trident for 4 damage.
Enemy spearman used spear for 2 damage and took 4 in retaliation.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Tomas's companions showed us the high bank through the woods. They will lead our land fighters. We take the lower wheel through the reeds.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Vale
dialogue.text: Senn says the council will hang deserters first. Your testimony will not save you.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: He forged the council's order. Hear the clerk, or answer for holding this flood above the village.

dialogue.speaker: Edda
dialogue.text: Bring me to the beacon. I will signal only when both wheels are ours.

dialogue.speaker: Edda
dialogue.text: Both flags up. Open together—now.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: The tide is home. Tomas should have seen it.

dialogue.speaker: Edda
dialogue.text: Put someone from each shore beside each wheel. Keep this from happening again.

dialogue.speaker: Edda
dialogue.text: The next sounding chart has two signatures. One from the quay, one from the reef.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: And if the numbers disagree, we go out together and measure again.

campaign.outcome: Mission complete. The company can rest and regroup.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: The tide should have returned by dawn. Our nets are dry; their boats are on the mud. This is no quarrel either shore can afford.

dialogue.speaker: Edda
dialogue.text: Vale's men took the sounding posts. I saw a sluice order bearing the council seal, but the date was cut from an older sheet.

dialogue.speaker: Postmaster Harl
dialogue.text: Captain Vale sent us to hold these posts for the factor's salvage crew. Bring your accusation to the council; you will not cross here.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Then we take the posts and bring the pilot. Leave the fishing houses standing.

dialogue.speaker: Tomas
dialogue.text: I was hired to guard a salvage crew. Today Senn ordered us to set the ship alight. There are still people down there.

dialogue.speaker: Edda
dialogue.text: I can bring them out along the keel. Hold this landing until the sixth bell; nobody touches the quarry gate before then.

dialogue.speaker: Foreman Cale
dialogue.text: The factor's ledger is company property. Clear the landing and burn the books.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: A debt cannot give you ownership of a person. We take the books after we get everyone out.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: These are the original accounts. He rewrote the council's order, then made each village pay for the delay. Keep them dry; I still have two colleagues below.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: We carry his testimony too. The clerk says we need both gates and the beacon; nobody else will die in a release we could have prevented.
